rule: No suggestion is implemented because it is listed here. A reviewer sets chosen_path for a suggestion id and records who chose it and when. Until then the suggestion is 'awaiting review' and nothing is built.
how_to_record_a_choice: Edit this file: set decisions[<suggestion id>] = {"chosen_path": "<the path label>", "chosen_by": "<name>", "chosen_on": "<YYYY-MM-DD>", "note": "<optional>"}. Then rebuild with console/build.py. The Suggestions page renders the choice and the build fails if a chosen path is not one of the published options.
